youtube.title: Dhanteras par bartan kyun kharidte hain? 🪔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Samudra manthan ke samay jab devta aur asur kshir sagar ko math rahe the, tab sabse ant mein Bhagwan Dhanvantari prakat hue. Unke hath mein amrit se bhara kalash tha.

Isi shubh smriti mein Dhanteras par hum naye bartan kharidte hain, taki ghar mein sukh, svasthya aur samriddhi ka kalash sada bhara rahe.

Katha ka strot: Shrimad Bhagavata Purana, skandha 8, adhyay 8.
